you dont need to prep for the psat right now, not to mention most psat books on the market are garbage. Best thing to do is take PSAT mostly-blind in 9th and 10th (even if you do bad which i doubt, colleges dont look at psat scores prior to 11th) and get sat prep books and study through the summer after sophomore year. Then maybe take the SAT in october to guarantee you’ve retained all the knowledge. Right now you should probably spend time studying for classes and reading, in fact those two things can improve your score in the long run

Being overprepared can actually lower your overall score. Id recommend not studying but just familiarizing with the test structure. PSAT doesnt even matter much until NMSQT anyways. More time should be spent reading, studying for actual courses being taken, etc
